parsed.why: Unenforced sodomy statute secondary, but police documented detaining, beating, humiliating gender-nonconforming presentation; lethal violence with impunity; no SO/GI recourse. State-directed targeting dominates, placing high-risk severe end.

No criminal law, but Pride clampdown, no SO/GI protection, routine trans healthcare discrimination with ID mismatch, and documented physical/sexual violence risk, especially northern provinces; thin recourse elevates risk.

Decriminalized conduct and no clothing/facility law, but new LGBTQ-propaganda statute criminalizes public expression with arrest/fine; no protections, hate violence unrecorded, uninvestigated incident; legal threat outweighs social tolerance.

Removed gender-impersonation offence, sentencing covers gender identity, documented third-gender acceptance, first Pride; same-sex conduct criminal but unenforced and tangential. No traveler targeting; everyday exposure low but partner risk nonzero.
Strong GI hate-crime/hate-speech protections and no criminal law, offset by chain changing-room denial, care limits, and organized anti-trans politics; recourse and friendliness keep it reduced-risk.
